duringExerciseImmediateInsights.note: Wrangler D1 Insights snapshots lag and cover a rolling 24-hour window; the small immediate delta is not a complete per-exercise query counter.

latestRolling24HourSnapshot.note: Includes all staging SQL fingerprints in the rolling window, including earlier rehearsal attempts and cleanup. It cannot be attributed solely to the 24-learner run.

freePlanDailyProjection.scenario: 100 learners per day, two 67-minute Section Exam attempts per learner (200 attempts total); a deliberately simple extrapolation from this staging exercise, not a qualified capacity result.

workerInvocations.caveat: Does not add sign-in, navigation, retries, or other product use; the concurrent exercise itself had a 46.77% service-error rate.

d1RowsRead.method: Scale the entire observed 24-hour read aggregate of 56,010 by 200/23, attributing all of it to the 23 created Attempts, then add two row reads per timed heartbeat for each projected Attempt.
d1RowsRead.caveat: This intentionally conservative attribution is only a rough upper extrapolation. Insights aggregation is delayed and includes other staging activity; a successful 200-Attempt measurement is still required.

d1RowsWritten.method: Scale the entire observed 24-hour write aggregate of 344 by 200/23, then add one row written per projected heartbeat.
d1RowsWritten.caveat: Rough upper extrapolation from the delayed aggregate; the failed exercise did not measure 200 completed timed Attempts.

d1Storage.caveat: Only transient staging size was measured; a retained daily growth rate was not established.

workerCpu.caveat: Worker CPU percentiles were not captured. Zero client-observed 1102 errors does not prove CPU headroom.

reason: The 24-learner rehearsal produced 2160 generic 503 service_unavailable responses and completed only 3 of 23 created Attempts.
